name: 1ClickWebsite
author: 1ClickWebsite
description: Build and edit WordPress websites for local service businesses, and run Lead Gen batches of personalized demo sites, from your AI agent. Official remote MCP server (OAuth or API key).

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Credits left on the account: site credits (one per create_site) and Lead Gen credits (one per business in a batch, at least 5 per batch).

tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Looks a business up on Google by name, so create_site can fill in its details. Add the city, phone or website to narrow it down. When confident is false, show the matches to the user and ask which one is theirs.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The website designs a new site can use. Pass a template's templateId and themeId to create_site.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Builds a new website for a business and uses one site credit. Easiest: pass googlePlaceId from find_business and its name, address, phone, hours, website, category and services are filled in from Google; anything else you pass overrides them. When the business has no address on Google, also pass addressCity and addressRegion so its service areas can be filled in. Confirm the business and the credit with the user first. Building takes several minutes; follow it with site_status.

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: Where a site is in its build (progress, current step), and its link once ready.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: The account's websites, newest first, with their links and status. A complete site, or one moved to its own domain (status "moved"), can be edited with the site editing tools.

tools.name: list_lead_gen_templates
tools.description: The designs a Lead Gen batch can use; pass one's key as templateKey to create_lead_gen_batch.

tools.name: create_lead_gen_batch
tools.description: Builds a one-page demo website for each business in the list, to show prospects. Uses one Lead Gen credit per business (at least 5 per batch). Confirm the list and cost with the user first. Pages build in the background; follow them with get_lead_gen_batch.

tools.name: list_lead_gen_batches
tools.description: Recent Lead Gen batches with their status, and the Lead Gen credits left.

tools.name: get_lead_gen_batch
tools.description: A batch and each business in it, with its page link (public_url) once built. Item ids are what update_lead_gen_site takes.

tools.name: update_lead_gen_batch
tools.description: Changes a batch's default color, background or logo size. Pages using the default change at once; pages with their own setting keep it.

tools.name: update_lead_gen_site
tools.description: Changes one business's demo page: its name, contact details, logo, color, background or contact mode.

tools.name: export_lead_gen_batch
tools.description: The batch as CSV (business details and page links), e.g. for a mail merge or CRM import.

tools.name: site_guide
tools.description: Start here before editing a site: how it is built (OCF fields, collections, design tokens) and the rules for changing it.

tools.name: get_tools
tools.description: Lists the 1ClickWebsite tools in a group, with what each does and its inputs. Groups: sites (credits, templates, creating sites and following their builds), lead_gen (demo-site batches for prospect lists), editing (changing a finished site's content, pages, SEO, design and media; start with site_guide). Run a tool with run_read_tool or run_change_tool.

tools.name: run_read_tool
tools.description: Runs a tool from get_tools that only reads (run_with: run_read_tool), such as list_sites, site_status or site_guide.

tools.name: run_change_tool
tools.description: Runs a tool from get_tools that makes changes (run_with: run_change_tool): creating sites or Lead Gen batches (uses credits), or editing a site. Confirm with the user first.
